deduplication.note: One record per gauge_uid. Cross-network duplicate resolution is performed upstream in nsw_rainfall_stations.csv, not in this build.

selection.rule: live == true AND cls in {A,B,C,D,E} AND quality_status in {ok,unassessed}
selection.source_rule: configured series: MHL, then WDO, then WaterNSW; without a series id, source=master.networks and data_identifier=master.sources verbatim

ifd_validation.rule: Each row non-decreasing across AEP columns from common to rare; each column non-decreasing with duration. Exemption: rare columns may decrease at the 1440-1800 minute step only, by at most 5 mm or 3 percent of the 1440 value, whichever is larger. Exempted cells are listed.

wdo_identity.rule: dedupe keeper = identity only; every include_for_observation_union member ts_id is carried in wdo_member_ts_ids and must be unioned by any observation read
wdo_identity.nsw_gate: point_in_polygon against LGA boundaries; bounding box is never used
